title.en: What Passes Between Us · Eight Languages

summary.en: The guide and seven essays add complete German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Korean rewrites. Books, promises, letters, apprenticeship and departure retain their full arguments and examples. The editions distinguish expectations from consent, repair from agreement, and leaving from erasing what remains. Existing Chinese and English prose is unchanged.
summary.zh: 导读与七篇正文新增德法西日韩完整独立重写。保留书、承诺、通信、师徒与离开的全部论证和例子，分清期待与同意、修复与解决分歧，以及退出与抹去留下的影响；原有中英繁正文不变。
summary.zh-hant: 導讀與七篇正文新增德法西日韓完整獨立重寫。保留書、承諾、通信、師徒與離開的全部論證和例子，分清期待與同意、修復與解決分歧，以及退出與抹去留下的影響；原有中英繁正文不變。
